name: What should be considered when widening an exterior door opening compared to an interior one?

mainEntity.name: What should be considered when widening an exterior door opening compared to an interior one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Widening an exterior door—such as expanding a single entry door into French doors or a sliding patio door—always affects a primary load-bearing exterior wall. You must replace the existing short header with a longer, deeper structural beam designed to carry the roof and upper floor load across the wider span. Exterior framing also involves cutting back exterior siding, integrating proper weather-resistant flashing and house wrap, and installing an exterior-grade sill pan to prevent water intrusion, which interior partition framing does not require.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior widening always requires a larger load-bearing header, exterior structural support, and integration with weatherproofing, house wrap, and sill flashing.
